items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: I knew him in New York for years.

ctx.x: There was a Johnny Fisher, a trumpet player, around New York.

He played pretty good trumpet. He played with some pretty good band but he was on the blues tour a little bit. Well he came down here later and then he went to the Gulf Coast. Well I don't know where he is. But he and Jack Miranda. You knew John the Fisher that I'm talking about? Yeah, with Jack Miranda and all those guys down here. I knew him in New York for years. Who was he with in New York? I don't know, he played different bands. But like I say, he's hit the blues pretty good a lot of times and he'd lose out…
